source_basis: hand-authored from checked-in tests/docs evidence indexes; no scripts, tests, builds, lints, formatters, generators, npm, cmake, gh, or push were run for this index

policy.primary_axis: fixture family ownership before issue closeout
policy.canonical_positive_rule: only hand-authored canonical Objective-C 3 behavior fixtures may be positive behavior evidence
policy.retired_surface_rule: retired modes, retired adapters, alternate acceptance paths, retired-source lanes, unsupported features, and unresolved runtime surfaces are rejection, strict-error, or absent-support evidence
policy.generated_fixture_rule: generated artifacts are provenance and schema evidence only; they never define positive native behavior
policy.issue_closeout_rule: issue docs summarize committed evidence and must point back to owned fixture families or owner indexes

families.retired_disposition: canonical manifest positives are canonical behavior only; retired behavior is referenced through negative or strict-error families
